content: न्यस्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Cast down, thrown or laid down, deposited. .²2 Put in, inserted, applied; न्यस्ताक्षराः <ls>Ku. 1. 7</ls>. .²3 Depicted, drawn; चित्रन्यस्त. .²4 Consigned, delivered or transferred to; अहमपि तव सूनावायुषि न्यस्तराज्यः <ls>V. 5. 17</ls>. .²5 Leaning, resting on. .²6 Given up, set aside, resigned. .²7 Mystically touched; नित्यं न्यस्तषडङ्गचक्रनिहितं हृत्पद्ममध्योदितम् <ls>Māl. 5. 2</ls>. .²8 Exposed (for sale; क्रयाय न्यस्त). .²9 Put on, donned; न्यस्तालक्तकरक्तमाल्यवसना <ls>Māl. 5. 24</ls>. .²10 Having the low tone (as a vowel).
